name: Liese
source:
“Um…why did someone like me suddenly become an attendant to Lady Antonia?” 

Born in Austria.
Hobby: Reading
Likes: Torte
Dislikes: Milk

A servant at Schönbrunn Palace. A cheerful and positive-thinking woman. She is working as an attendant to Marie Antoinette. As her entire family is employed at the castle, they live in lodging quarters on the premises. She has loved books since she was a child, so much that she taught herself to speak French.

[From [url=http://dreamer-chan.tumblr.com/post/145074546359/bara-ni-kakusareshi-verite-main-cast]Tumblr[/url]]
